brief: A web ritual where strangers exchange sealed future promises that unlock after a chosen date, with anonymous profiles and trust receipts.
A living atlas of household objects where people attach memories, voice notes and hand-me-down stories to everyday things.
A quiet digital room for two people to leave unsent letters that become visible only when both choose to open them.
A participatory sound map made from tiny recordings people pin to moments in a city, forming an evolving audio constellation.
A shared garden of unfinished ideas where visitors plant fragments, combine them and grow new branches over time.
A personal object lineage where each possession carries origin, care history, stories and future handoff notes.
A digital time capsule for families to collect small observations and reveal them together years later.
An anonymous kindness exchange where one small act creates a chain that can be followed without exposing identities.
A dream atlas where people place recurring symbols, connect patterns and compare how themes evolve over time.
A collaborative question tree where each answer unlocks a deeper branch and participants can fork alternative lines of thought.
A private ritual log where small groups record repeated gestures, mark changes and reveal patterns across seasons.
A collection of imagined future objects where visitors inspect origin stories, alternate uses and speculative histories.
